Users authenticated through a non-admin collection could receive unintended access to framework-managed records.

You are affected if:
- Your application uses multiple authentication-enabled collections.
- Untrusted users can authenticate through a collection other than the configured admin collection.

Applications using only the configured admin authentication collection are not affected by this issue.

### Patches
Users should upgrade Payload to `>= 3.90.0`.

Payload now restricts default access to affected framework-managed collections to users from the configured admin collection.

### Workarounds
Upgrading is recommended.
